create_chat_completion: create a chat completion call with messages and optional streaming for conversational AI
run_text_generation: run text generation from a prompt with configurable parameters like max_new_tokens and temperature
build_text_to_image: build an image from a text prompt using a diffusion model with optional guidance scale
summarize_text: summarize input text using a configured summarization model and return the generated summary
test_image_classification: test image classification on an image file and return predicted labels with confidence scores
